brief: The canvas is filled with a perpetual, continuous vortex of semi-transparent textual characters. This amorphous stream writhes and flows constantly. Periodically, the movement slows as the characters begin to coalesce. They momentarily arrange themselves into fully legible, sequential lines, adopting the stark, high-contrast appearance of old newsprint. Following this brief moment of clarity, the structured lines do not collapse; instead, the letters visibly scatter apart and dissipate, gradually dissolving back into the surrounding, flowing vortex of text.

statement: This sketch depicts an endless flow of semi-transparent text characters that swirl in a continuous vortex. At regular intervals, the characters briefly organize into clear, high-contrast lines reminiscent of old newsprint. These structured arrangements then scatter apart and dissolve back into the flowing stream. The visual effect captures the tension between order and chaos, with the text both coalescing into readable form and then breaking apart again, creating a mesmerizing rhythm of formation and dissolution.
